description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating Kafka connections and producers within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: KafkaConnectionFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating Kafka sinks, including obtaining connection identifiers and creating new Kafka producers.

methods.name: connectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the Kafka connection.

methods.name: newProducer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Kafka producer instance for sending messages.
